confidence_notes: Restaurant anchors are medium-low confidence. Tokyo official eating-out averages (beer about 667 yen, coffee about 622 yen, Jan 2026) were scaled down for Aomori, and citycost.org Aomori figures were used as a cross-check; that site is crowdsourced and undated. Teishoku and ramen ranges come from travel guides. Cocktail and wine are weaker, estimated from the Tokyo casual-bar range and the beer anchor. Accommodation is a holistic model estimate with no live listings checked. The FX observation is NOT verified from rba.gov.au: all RBA searches failed (rate limited or no rba.gov.au results). The 0.703 USD per AUD figure is a secondhand snapshot from a third-party API vendor, dated 2026-07-31, and it is not the latest RBA observation for 2026-10-16. The source_url is the canonical RBA exchange-rate page, which was not opened. Verify the FX before use. Yen-to-USD conversion for the anchors assumes about 159 JPY per USD, implied by citycost conversions; this is not a live rate.
comparable_city_reasoning: Japanese regional city priced below Tokyo. Yen prices were taken from Tokyo official eating-out averages, discounted for Aomori using citycost Aomori-versus-Tokyo comparisons (beer about 27 percent cheaper overall). Hotel and hostel anchors are general knowledge of a small northern Japanese city, with no search performed.
